column1: # MOVE_REFS v1 rules (make/m3/tooling/jdk-naming/move_refs.py) for the m3/collections + m3/algorithms move into the JDK module
# src/jdk.m3.collections (MOVE_TO_JDK_MODULE v3, keep-pom mode): the module jdk.m3.collections of the Maven bridge is
# its descriptor m3/collections/src/main/java/module-info.java plus the package sources under
# native sources in src/jdk.m3.collections/share/native/libm3collections, native tests in test/jdk/jdk/m3/collections/native.
# FILES: every workflow, and the scripts and poms a workflow runs that name the old paths (census 2026-11-08).
# Literals never end in a space.

column3: sorted(path for base in ("m3/collections/src/main/java", "src/jdk.m3.collections/share/classes/jdk/m3/collections", "src/jdk.m3.collections/share/classes/jdk/internal/m3/collections") for path in (root / base).rglob("*.java"))
